research.facts:
ADHD Classroom Accommodations Study
**Story Type:** NEW STORY — National Parenting pillar
**Confidence:** HIGH (JAMA Pediatrics peer-reviewed, multi-source)
**Key Facts:**
- JAMA Pediatrics study published **November 13, 2026** — HIGH
- **255 children**, K–6, enrolled in summer treatment program 2022–2025 — HIGH
- Four accommodations tested: extended time, frequent breaks, standing desk, low-distraction workspace — HIGH
- **None of the four accommodations** produced measurable improvement in outcomes — HIGH
- Some accommodations actually **reduced academic productivity** — HIGH
- Behavioral interventions cut rule violations **37%** — HIGH
- Stimulant medication cut violations **61%** and increased correct completed assignments **22%** — HIGH
- Setting caveat: summer treatment program, not a regular classroom — HIGH
- DOI: **10.1001/jamapediatrics.2026.5973** — HIGH
**Sources:**
- News Medical/Net: "Common classroom accommodations fail to improve outcomes for children with ADHD" — https://news-medical.net/news/20261113/Common-classroom-accommodations-fail-to-improve-outcomes-for-children-with-ADHD.aspx
**Freshness verification:** Published November 13, 2026. First COS Parenting coverage.

research.facts:
Cipton Bike Helmet Recall + Bambora Sling Warning
**Story Type:** NEW STORY — National Parenting/Recall pillar
**Confidence:** HIGH (CPSC official)
**Key Facts — Cipton Recall:**
- CPSC recall announced **November 19, 2026** — HIGH
- **~16,730 units** affected — HIGH
- Model: **CPSK300CC**, small size, white color, built-in LED strip — HIGH
- Sold at **Dick's Sporting Goods and JCPenney**, April 2024–May 2026 — HIGH
- Price: approximately **$35** — HIGH
- Failure: fail impact attenuation, positional stability, and certification requirements — HIGH
- Remedy: stop using, cut straps, write "Recalled" on helmet, email photo for **full refund** — HIGH
- Risk: Serious head injury
**Key Facts — Bambora Sling Warning:**
- CPSC **warning** (not formal recall) issued **November 12, 2026** — HIGH
- Company did not cooperate with CPSC — HIGH
- Sold at **Bamboraco.com** for **$59–$118** — HIGH
- Failure: restraint strap can separate — HIGH
- Hazard: **fall hazard for infants** — HIGH
- Remedy: stop use immediately, cut fabric in half, dispose — HIGH
- **No refund available** — HIGH
**Sources:**
- CPSC Cipton recall: https://cpsc.gov/Recalls/2027/Cipton-Recalls-Bicycle-Helmets-Due-to-Risk-of-Serious-Injury-or-Death-from-Head-Injury-Violate-Mandatory-Standard-for-Bicycle-Helmets
- CPSC Bambora warning: https://www.cpsc.gov/Warnings/2027/CPSC-Warns-Consumers-to-Stop-Using-Bambora-Sling-Carriers-Immediately-Due-to-Risk-of-Serious-Injury-or-Death-from-Fall-Hazard-Violate-Mandatory-Standard-for-Sling-Carriers
**Freshness verification:** Cipton Nov 19, Bambora Nov 12 — both new this week. Prior coverage: Nov 24 S2 Kidsview bouncer; Nov 23 S1 SHEIN rattle — these are new, distinct recalls.
